Shandong Binzhou Huike Cyclodextrin Technology Co., Ltd. is a specialized chemical enterprise located in the Boxing Economic Development Zone of Binzhou, Shandong, China. Centered on the science and industrialization of cyclodextrins, the company focuses on the research, production, and application development of cyclodextrin and cyclodextrin derivatives. Its offerings typically include native cyclodextrins (such as α-, β-, and γ-cyclodextrin) and a range of functional derivatives designed to enhance solubility, stability, bioavailability, controlled release, and masking of odors or tastes across diverse end-use sectors.

Serving pharmaceuticals, nutraceuticals, food and beverages, personal care and cosmetics, agrochemicals, and environmental remediation, Shandong Binzhou Huike Cyclodextrin Technology Co., Ltd. supports customers with both catalog products and tailored solutions. The company emphasizes formulation support and inclusion-complex technology to help partners solve challenges in drug delivery, ingredient stabilization, and product performance. It maintains modern production and quality-control infrastructure to deliver consistent batch quality, with a focus on safety, regulatory compliance, and environmental responsibility.

Beyond manufacturing, the company prioritizes application-driven R&D, pilot-to-scale support, and responsive technical service. It aims to build long-term partnerships by aligning cyclodextrin chemistry with real-world product needs—whether that means improving solubility of poorly soluble actives, reducing volatility of flavors and fragrances, enhancing shelf life and sensory profiles, or enabling greener process routes. Strategically positioned in Shandong’s chemical industry cluster and logistics network, Shandong Binzhou Huike Cyclodextrin Technology Co., Ltd. provides reliable supply and efficient delivery to domestic and international customers, helping accelerate innovation from laboratory concept to market-ready products.
